# Crasoft

> Crasoft is a US software company founded in 2020. We build TFONE, a family of apps for trucking companies, and custom software for businesses and founders.

## Pages

- [Home](https://crasoftinc.com/): what Crasoft builds, our products, services, process, FAQ and how to book a call

## Products (TFONE, for trucking companies)

- [TFONE TMS](https://www.thetfone.com): one place to manage loads, dispatch, drivers, trucks, billing and documents.
- [TFONE Driver App](https://www.thetfone.com): drivers see loads, update status and send documents from the road.
- TFONE Navigation: plans routes based on a truck's height and size.
- TFSign: sign documents online, without printing or scanning.
- Relay TMS Sync: a Chrome extension that syncs loads from Relay into TFONE TMS.
